selected_experts.reason: To confirm the specific botanical identity of the fruit and distinguish it from similar gourds or zucchini.
To verify the boundary between the cucumber and the complex background of leaves/soil, checking for edge bleeding or fusion artifacts common in AI generation.
To assess overall texture consistency of the leaves and soil, looking for subtle 'smearing' or unnatural patterns.
To ensure the cucumber sits correctly within the depth plane of the garden bed and doesn't float above the soil.

focus_areas: Boundary integrity between cucumber and surrounding foliage
Texture consistency of the cucumber skin (prickles vs. noise)
Structural plausibility of the stem attachment point
Naturalness of the yellow flower morphology
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the connection point between the cucumber stem and the vine. AI often struggles with this specific junction, creating fused or ambiguous geometry. Also, verify if the yellow flower at the tip looks structurally coherent or like a melted blob of yellow pixels.
